io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.groups

Class LockedItemGroup

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.ItemGroup
      • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.groups.LockedItemGroup
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Keyed

    public class LockedItemGroup
extends ItemGroup
    Represents a ItemGroup that cannot be opened until the parent group(s) are fully unlocked.

    See ItemGroup for the complete documentation.

    See Also:
    ItemGroup, SeasonalItemGroup
